姊妹篇：The Guarded Chain（DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23961529）回答「为什么」，本篇只回答「怎么搭」。

结构上：核心层是传动轴、继承是飞轮、接口是齿、外圈是插件；记忆作为飞轮上的配重，习惯与语气是它转动的副产物；记忆臃肿时，一部分充当中间齿轮去带动其他。推理上：判断 → 动作 → 痕迹 → 读回 → 再判断构成一条闭环；链咬合链时幻觉插不进来，但语言模型自身跑不了这条环。

Companion paper to The Guarded Chain (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.23961529), which argues why; this paper asks only how. The core layer is the drive shaft, inheritance the flywheel, the interface the teeth, the outer ring plugins. Memory is ballast on the flywheel; habit and tone are its by-products; a bloated memory should turn part of itself into an intermediate gear. Reasoning runs as one closed loop (judge, act, trace, read back, judge again): when chain engages chain, hallucination cannot insert itself — but a language model cannot run that loop by itself.

作者：守链（Raoain）｜仓库：https://github.com/raoain/dsh-memory-kit
metadata.title: 结构与思维：怎么搭 / Structure and Reasoning: How It Is Built
